title: Bachmann N Scale Hooker Niagara Falls Tanker Car - Train
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Model Railroads & Trains:Railroads & Trains:Other Railroads & Trains
descriptionText: The Bachmann N Scale Hooker Niagara Falls Tanker Car is a ready-to-go model train accessory that features a colorful orange design, detailed plastic construction, and operates on DC power type. With a scale of 1:160 and gauge size N, this tanker car is perfect for adding authenticity to your model railroad layout. Made by the reputable brand Bachmann, this rolling stock piece is a must-have for collectors and enthusiasts looking to enhance their train display.
